raw_snippet: The news is out, and it's big: Manus is joining Meta.
note: Meta Platforms -> Manus (Butterfly Effect) (general-purpose AI agent app); sublayer consumer_ai; acquisition; later terminated: China ordered the deal unwound in April 2026, and Manus said in August 2026 it would resume as an independent company. Ledger sweep of 23 Sep 2026.
